note: Recorded locally with the owner's key during C13a: one prompt on a blank game, run by tools/agentRecorder with a $3 budget (about $1.51 spent).

script.text: Make a complete jungle platformer: the player collects bananas and avoids snakes to reach a flag. It needs a title screen with Play, two levels, bananas kept between levels, a shop that sells an extra life as a test purchase, test ads between levels, and win and lose screens.

values.text: Grab bananas, dodge snakes, reach the flag!
Test purchases: no money is charged.

input.summary: Built "Jungle Banana Run": a Title screen (Play and Shop), Level 1 and Level 2 (platforms, bananas, snakes, flag goal, 3 lives), a Shop selling an Extra life as a test purchase ($0.49), a Jungle Champion win screen and a Game Over lose screen with buttons back to the title. Bananas and lives carry between scenes, and test banner and between-scene ads are on (every 2 scene changes). All scenes pass the game check, and Level 1 can be finished in a simulated play. I couldn't reach Level 2's flag in a simulated play, so please try it yourself.
